architectural_verdict: Abaqus/Standard native Newton-Raphson solver does not support inequality-constrained DOFs (d >= d0). An unconstrained Newton step produces diffuse artificial phase advance across 2769 nodes (max delta_d = 9.40e-02, min delta_d = 4.34e-05) because Abaqus/Standard lacks active-set bound constraints. Enforcing genuine complementarity (d >= d0, lambda >= 0, lambda*(d-d0) = 0) requires either an external Primal-Dual Active Set (PDAS) driver or custom Lagrange multiplier elements.
